title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
constraints: All integers in nums are unique.
nums is sorted and possibly rotated.
The unrotated sorted array is also a valid input.

examples.explanation: The smallest rotation still follows the same binary-search rule.

solutionApproaches.title: Linear Scan
solutionApproaches.explanation: Inspect every value and keep the smallest; correct but does not meet the logarithmic-time requirement.

solutionApproaches.title: Binary Search on Rotation Point
solutionApproaches.explanation: Compare mid with right. If nums[mid] > nums[right], minimum is in the right half; otherwise in the left half including mid.
